name: Exec Cluster E06: CPPI Portfolio Insurance — Fixed Floor
description: Tests: cppi dynamic allocation with floor protection
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC TEST: CPPI Portfolio Insurance
# Tests: E06 (cppi with multiplier=3, floor_pct=0.8)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === SIGNAL: SMA trend filter ===
sma_200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)
is_above = close > sma_200
is_below = close < sma_200

held_long = hold_until(is_above, is_below)

# === EXECUTION ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long)

# E06: CPPI with 80% floor, 3x multiplier
cppi(multiplier=3, floor_pct=0.8)

# Protective stop
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=10)
